abstract: BACKGROUND: The optimal treatment strategy for patients with clinical stage I (CS-1) seminoma is controversial. The objective of the current study was to evaluate the outcomes for patients considered to be at high risk of disease recurrence with a tumor size ≥6 cm. Patients were treated with either adjuvant radiotherapy (RT) or followed with surveillance. METHODS: From the Danish Testicular Cancer database, the authors identified 473 patients with CS-1 seminoma with a tumor size ≥6 cm. Of these, 254 patients underwent adjuvant RT and 219 were followed with surveillance. Cumulative incidence function was applied to estimate the risk of disease recurrence, risk of second malignant neoplasm, and risk of receiving >1 line of treatment. Survival of the 2 groups was compared with the log-rank test and Cox model including age at diagnosis. RESULTS: No significant differences were found with regard to overall survival or risk of a second malignant neoplasm. Patients undergoing adjuvant RT received more treatments per patient than patients followed with surveillance, but there was no significant difference noted with regard to the risk of receiving >1 line of treatment. The 10-year cumulative incidence of disease recurrence was 32% versus 2.8%, respectively, for patients followed with surveillance and adjuvant RT. In patients followed with surveillance who developed disease recurrence, there was a high incidence of second recurrences after RT. CONCLUSIONS: The 10-year overall survival was found to be similar irrespective of primary treatment. Adjuvant RT was found to effectively reduce the rate of disease recurrence but resulted in the overtreatment of approximately two-thirds of the patients. The high incidence of second disease recurrences after RT in the patients followed with surveillance needs be addressed in future studies. Cancer 2017;123:1212-1218. © 2016 American Cancer Society.
abstract_ja:
背景：臨床病期I（CS-1）セミノーマ患者に対する最適な治療戦略は議論がある。本研究の目的は、腫瘍径≥6 cmで再発リスクが高いと考えられる患者の転帰を評価することであった。患者は術後放射線療法（RT）を受けるか、経過観察を受けた。
方法：デンマーク精巣がんデータベースから、腫瘍径≥6 cmのCS-1セミノーマ患者473例を同定した。このうち254例は術後RTを受け、219例は経過観察を受けた。累積発生率関数を用いて、再発リスク、second malignant neoplasmのリスク、および1ライン以上の治療を受けるリスクを推定した。2群の生存はログランク検定と、診断時年齢を含むCoxモデルで比較した。
結果：全生存率または second malignant neoplasmのリスクに関して有意な差は認められなかった。術後RTを受けた患者は、経過観察を受けた患者よりも1人当たりの治療回数が多かったが、1ライン以上の治療を受けるリスクに有意差は認められなかった。10年累積再発率は、経過観察群で32%、術後RT群で2.8%であった。経過観察群で再発を生じた患者では、RT後の再発の再発率が高かった。
結論：10年全生存率は、初回治療にかかわらず同様であった。術後RTは再発率を効果的に低下させたが、患者の約3分の2が過剰治療となった。経過観察群でのRT後の再発の高率は、将来の研究で取り組む必要がある。Cancer 2017;123:1212-1218. © 2016 American Cancer Society.
